remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00)
spec2def(mfreadwrite.dll mfreadwrite.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(mfreadwrite registry mf_classes.idl)

# mfreadwrite.dll is all Rust (mfreadwrite-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mfreadwrite-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# reader.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mfreadwrite-rust/src/mfreadwrite/reader.rs)
# writer.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mfreadwrite-rust/src/mfreadwrite/writer.rs)
set(MFREADWRITE_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/mfreadwrite/mf_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(mfreadwrite mfreadwrite-cargo mfreadwrite.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE mfreadwrite-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mfreadwrite_r ${MFREADWRITE_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources wineheaders)
add_dependencies(mfreadwrite psdk wineheaders)
